product_one_liner.value: WindBorne operates autonomous long-duration weather balloons and combines their atmospheric observations with proprietary AI forecasting models to provide global weather data and forecasts for individuals and enterprise users.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its balloon constellation, AI forecasts, and individual and enterprise offerings.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer do not link to a public pricing page; the site directs prospective users to contact the company.

named_customers.notes: The article explicitly calls NOAA an operational customer and describes WindBorne's six-month U.S. Navy contract.

employee_band.notes: Unify reports 85 observed employee profiles in July 2026, and Crunchbase lists a 51-100 headcount band; LinkedIn's broader 51-200 range is consistent but not precise enough for the requested band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Redwood City, California, as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile lists 2019 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The index includes multiple technical posts, including posts on AI data assimilation, building the WeatherMesh AI model, balloon communications, and flight software, with technical-team authorship described for the Engineering Notebook series.

public_docs.notes: WindBorne has public API documentation with multiple guides and articles, including Getting Started, authentication, integrations, models, observations, and forecasts.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current listed openings include Sensor Data Engineer and other engineering/operations roles, but no job title matching the specified AI/ML/data-science criteria; data-engineer roles do not count under the question's rule.

model_provider.value: WindBorne's own WeatherMesh-6 AI forecast model; its MetaMesh product blends WeatherMesh with named numerical weather prediction and other forecast models.
model_provider.notes: The public FAQ names WeatherMesh-6 as WindBorne's AI forecast model. MetaMesh is described as a multi-model blend; no third-party LLM provider is named.

compliance_certs.notes: The company's legal page was reviewed and names none of the listed certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS). Its FAA/ICAO operational compliance statements are not among the requested certifications.

last_funding.notes: WindBorne announced a $37 million Series B on August 5, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series B falls within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings list has no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: WindBorne announced the WindBorne Weather Events API feature on October 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster identifies the current executives as founders and shows no C-level or VP-level joiner within the 12-month window; no departure is announced on the page.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public API documentation and current job listings were reviewed; neither names a CRM or sales/marketing system.
